disposition: A database-scoped typed route family exists (documents GET/PUT/DELETE, query + cancel, families read/write, schemas, migrations, streams, sync sessions) and is tested against the scripted engine, while the engine itself serves documents, V1-compatible queries, and schema declare/status over TBEP against a real durable engine.
